<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Requires RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Rises, conservative observation and warning detection before crossing warn_margin, channel delivery within combined maxSilence, lag-buffered initial margin x_crit + eta * cap ≤ x₀, ContractRefines bounds for replacement/reconfig, and synchronous prodProcess for compose_laxSim_max/sum.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Direct LaxSim composition over coupled closedProcess traces without an explicit trace-decoupling step.
- Automatic synthesis of InterfaceContracts, ContractRefines witnesses, or live reconfig triggers from arbitrary subsystems.
- **Counterexample:** HiddenCouplingFailure.witness (hidden_coupling_interchange_failure): solo blindDrawer keeps 3 ≤ x forever from x₀ = 4, whereas blindDrawer ⊕ blindDrawer crashes to 0 by step 4. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/OpenComposition.lean)
- **Counterexample:** WideningWitness.narrow_blind_crashes: under a narrow blind interface, any rule pair with floor draw ≥ 1 crashes from 6 to 0 in 6 steps. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/OpenComposition.lean)
- **Counterexample:** ComposedNonLumpingWitness.no_reduced_law_prod: synchronous product WitnessTwoScale.P ⊗ P admits no ProjectedLaws.Commuting coarse reduction. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/OpenComposition.lean)
